dotnet bee defines - Manage framework default define files

Usage: dotnet bee defines <subcommand> [options]

Subcommands:
  materialize   Write embedded framework defaults to a target directory
  list          List the relative paths of all embedded defaults
  split-menu    Migrate a pre-flattening ProgramSettings.xml into a flat
                registry plus MenuSettings.xml

Run 'dotnet bee defines <subcommand> --help' for subcommand options.

result.stdout:
dotnet bee defines materialize - Write embedded framework defaults to a directory

Usage: dotnet bee defines materialize --path <directory> [options]

Options:
  --path, -p <dir>     Target directory (created if missing). Required.
  --overwrite          Overwrite existing files. Default: skip (preserves consumer customisations).
  --filter <prefix>    Only materialize files whose relative path starts with this prefix.
                       e.g. --filter TableSchema/ to write only schema files.
  --help, -h           Print this help text.

result.stdout:
dotnet bee defines split-menu - Migrate a pre-flattening ProgramSettings.xml

Usage: dotnet bee defines split-menu --path <DefinePath directory> [options]

Rewrites ProgramSettings.xml as a flat type registry and writes the categories
and items it used to carry to MenuSettings.xml beside it. Aborts when the same
progId is registered under more than one category.

Options:
  --path, -p <dir>     The DefinePath directory holding ProgramSettings.xml. Required.
  --overwrite          Replace an existing MenuSettings.xml. Default: refuse.
  --dry-run            Print what would be written without touching any file.
  --help, -h           Print this help text.
